DATA DIVISION.

*> PROCEDURE DIVISIONでは、プログラムが行う処理を書いていく。
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
    MAIN SECTION.
    	
      	ACCEPT N.
      
      	PERFORM N TIMES
      		ACCEPT INT
      		
      		UNSTRING INT DELIMITED ' '
      			INTO D1 D2
      		
      		IF D1 = D2 THEN
      			ADD 1 TO CNT
      			
      			IF CNT = 3 THEN
      				DISPLAY 'Yes'
      				EXIT PERFORM
      			END-IF
      		ELSE
      			MOVE 0 TO CNT
      		END-IF
      	END-PERFORM.
      	
      	IF CNT NOT = 3 THEN
      		DISPLAY 'No'
      	END-IF.
      	


*> プログラム終了！！お疲れ様でした。
    STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. 175B.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 INP        PIC  X(1100).
01 N          PIC  9(03).
01 P1         PIC  9(04) COMP.
01 P2         PIC  9(04) COMP.
01 I          PIC  9(04) COMP.
01 J          PIC  9(04) COMP.
01 K          PIC  9(04) COMP.
01 TBL1.
   03 L1      PIC  9(10) OCCURS 101.
01 TBL2.
   03 L2      PIC  9(10) OCCURS 100.
   03 K2      PIC  9(03) OCCURS 100.
01 L-C        PIC  9(03) COMP.
01 CNT        PIC  9(06) COMP.
01 OUT        PIC  Z(5)9.
*>
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
  ACCEPT N.
  ACCEPT INP.
*>       
  MOVE ZERO TO TBL1 TBL2.
  MOVE 1 TO P1.
  PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > N
    PERFORM VARYING P2 FROM P1 BY 1 UNTIL INP(P2:1) = ' '
    END-PERFORM
    MOVE INP(P1:P2 - P1) TO L1(I)
    COMPUTE P1 = P2 + 1
  END-PERFORM.
*>
  SORT L1 DESCENDING KEY L1.
*>
  MOVE 1     TO L-C.
  MOVE L1(1) TO L2(L-C)
  MOVE 1     TO K2(L-C)
  PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I >= N
    IF (L1(I + 1) < L1(I)) AND (L1(I + 1) > 0)
      ADD  1         TO L-C
      MOVE L1(I + 1) TO L2(L-C)
      MOVE 1         TO K2(L-C)
    ELSE
      ADD  1         TO K2(L-C)
    END-IF
  END-PERFORM.
*>
  MOVE 0 TO CNT.
  PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > L-C + 2
    COMPUTE J = I + 1
    PERFORM VARYING J FROM J BY 1 UNTIL J > L-C + 1
      COMPUTE K = J + 1                        
      PERFORM VARYING K FROM K BY 1 UNTIL K > L-C
        IF (L2(I) + L2(J) > L2(K)) AND
           (L2(J) + L2(K) > L2(I)) AND
           (L2(K) + L2(I) > L2(J)) 
          COMPUTE CNT = CNT + K2(I) * K2(J) * K2(K)
        END-IF
      END-PERFORM
    END-PERFORM
  END-PERFORM.
*>
  MOVE CNT TO OUT.
  DISPLAY FUNCTION TRIM(OUT).
  STOP RUN.

. The length of Stick 
i
 
(1 \leq i \leq N)

That is, find the number of triples of integers 
(i, j, k)

All values in input are integers.

Input

L_2

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. 175C.
*>
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 INP        PIC  X(51).
01 X          PIC S9(16) COMP.
01 WX         PIC  9(16) COMP.
01 K          PIC  9(16) COMP.
01 D          PIC  9(16) COMP.
01 S          PIC  9(16) COMP.
01 R          PIC  9(16) COMP.
01 ZA         PIC S9(16).
01 OUT        PIC  Z(16)9.
*> 
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
  ACCEPT INP.
  UNSTRING INP DELIMITED BY ' '
      INTO X K D.
*>
  MOVE X TO WX.
  DIVIDE WX BY D GIVING S REMAINDER R.
  IF (S > 0)
    IF (X > 0)
      IF (S > K)
        COMPUTE ZA = X - K * D
        MOVE 0 TO K
      ELSE
        COMPUTE ZA = X - S * D
        COMPUTE K  = K - S
      END-IF
    ELSE
      IF (S > K)
        COMPUTE ZA = X + K * D
        MOVE 0 TO K
      ELSE
        COMPUTE ZA = X + S * D
        COMPUTE K  = K - S
      END-IF
    END-IF
  ELSE
    MOVE X TO ZA
  END-IF.
*>
  IF (K > 0)
    DIVIDE K BY 2 GIVING S REMAINDER R
    IF (R = 0)
      MOVE ZA TO OUT
    ELSE
      IF (ZA > 0)
        COMPUTE OUT = ZA - D
      ELSE
        COMPUTE OUT = ZA + D
    END-IF
  ELSE
    MOVE ZA TO OUT
  END-IF.
*>
  DISPLAY FUNCTION TRIM(OUT).
  STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PROGRAM_ID.

ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
   SELECT SYSIN ASSIGN TO KEYBOARD ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL.

DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD SYSIN.
   01 INDATA  PIC X(60000).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 ln         PIC X(400).
01 maxlen     PIC 9(10) VALUE 100 COMP.
01 cur        PIC 9(10) VALUE 1 COMP.
01 i          PIC 9(10) VALUE 1 COMP.
01 j          PIC 9(10) COMP.
01 len        PIC 9(10) COMP.
01 accum      PIC 9(10) VALUE ZERO COMP.
01 ans        PIC 9(10).
01 zs         PIC Z(9)9.
01 N          PIC 9(10).
01 M          PIC 9(10).
01 A          PIC 9(10).

PROCEDURE DIVISION.
  ACCEPT ln.
  UNSTRING ln DELIMITED BY SPACE INTO N M.
  MOVE M TO maxlen.
  OPEN INPUT SYSIN.
  READ SYSIN INTO INDATA.
  CLOSE SYSIN.
  PERFORM maxlen TIMES
    PERFORM VARYING j FROM cur BY 1 UNTIL INDATA(j:1) = SPACE
    END-PERFORM
    COMPUTE len = j - cur
    MOVE INDATA(cur:len) TO A
    ADD A TO accum
    COMPUTE cur = j + 1
    ADD 1 TO i
  END-PERFORM.
  IF N < accum THEN
    DISPLAY -1
  ELSE
    COMPUTE ans = N - accum
    MOVE ans TO zs
    DISPLAY FUNCTION TRIM(zs)
  END-IF.
  STOP RUN.

        COMPUTE len = j - cur
        MOVE INP(cur:len) TO nm
        MOVE i TO y(nm)
        MOVE jix TO x(nm)
        COMPUTE cur = j + 1
        ADD 1 TO jix
    END-PERFORM
    ADD 1 TO i
END-PERFORM.

    ACCEPT nm
    IF y(nm) NOT = -1

        IF NUM = yoko(y(nm))

        END-IF
        ADD 1 TO tate(x(nm))
        IF NUM = tate(x(nm))

        END-IF
        IF y(nm) = x(nm)

        IF y(nm) = NUM - x(nm) + 1

WORKING-STORAGE                  SECTION.

    01 INP2    PIC X(13).
    01 N       PIC 9(6).
    01 K       PIC 9(6).

    01 cur     PIC 9(7) VALUE 1.
    01 i       PIC 9(18) VALUE 1.
    01 j       PIC 9(18).
    01 len     PIC 9(7).

    01 tmp     PIC 9(9).

    01 x1.
        03 x11 OCCURS 100000 DEPENDING ON maxlen INDEXED XX1 XX2.
            05 x PIC S9(10).
            05 y PIC 9(9).

    01 t       PIC 9(9).
    01 sm      PIC 9(9).

    01 flg     PIC 9(1).

    01 ans     PIC X(9).

    01 ZS      PIC Z(9)9.
    01 DUMMY   PIC X(1).

PROCEDURE                        DIVISION.
    ACCEPT INP2.

    UNSTRING INP2
    DELIMITED BY SPACE
    INTO N K.

    OPEN INPUT SYSIN.

    READ SYSIN INTO INP.

    CLOSE SYSIN.

    MOVE N TO maxlen.

    PERFORM maxlen TIMES

        PERFORM VARYING j FROM cur BY 1
            UNTIL INP(j:1) = SPACE
        END-PERFORM

        COMPUTE len = j - cur

        SET XX1 TO i

        MOVE INP(cur:len) TO x(XX1)
        MOVE x(XX1) TO y(XX1)

        COMPUTE cur = j + 1

        ADD 1 TO i

    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE ZERO TO flg.

    SET XX1 TO 1.
    SET XX2 TO K.

    IF ZERO <= x(XX1)
        MOVE y(XX2) TO sm
        MOVE 1 TO flg
    END-IF.

    COMPUTE tmp = N - K + 1.

    SET XX1 TO N.
    SET XX2 TO tmp.

    IF x(XX1) <= ZERO
        MOVE y(XX2) TO sm
        MOVE 1 TO flg
    END-IF.

    IF ZERO = flg
        MOVE INF TO sm
        PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL N < i
            COMPUTE tmp = i + K - 1

            IF N < tmp
                EXIT PERFORM
            END-IF

            SET XX1 TO i
            SET XX2 TO tmp

            IF x(XX1) <= ZERO
                IF ZERO <= x(XX2)
                    IF y(XX1) <= y(XX2)
                        COMPUTE t = y(XX1) * 2 + y(XX2)
                    ELSE
                        COMPUTE t = y(XX1) + y(XX2) * 2
                    END-IF

                    IF t < sm
                        MOVE t TO sm
                    END-IF
                ELSE
                    COMPUTE tmp = i + K

                    SET XX2 TO tmp

                    IF tmp <= N AND ZERO < x(XX2)
                        MOVE y(XX1) TO t
                        IF t < sm
                            MOVE t TO sm
                        END-IF
                    END-IF
                END-IF
            ELSE
                COMPUTE tmp = i - 1

                SET XX1 TO tmp

                IF x(XX1) < ZERO
                    MOVE y(XX2) TO t
                    IF t < sm
                        MOVE t TO sm
                    END-IF
                END-IF
            END-IF
        END-PERFORM
    END-IF

    MOVE sm TO ZS.

    PERFORM UNANS.

    DISPLAY ans(1:FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(ans)).
    STOP RUN.

UNANS                            SECTION.
    UNSTRING
        ZS DELIMITED BY ALL SPACE
        INTO DUMMY ans
    END-UNSTRING.

    INTO D G.

        DELIMITED BY SPACE

        MOVE pt TO p(i)

    COMPUTE mx = 2 ** D - 1.

    ADD 1 TO MAX_NUM GIVING mnnum.

                                  BY REFERENCE b_txt

                ADD p(j) TO point

        MOVE 1 TO flg

        PERFORM FILLPOINT

        IF 1 = flg THEN

            COMPUTE mnnum = FUNCTION MIN(mnnum, num)

        END-IF

    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE mnnum TO ZS.

    PERFORM UNANS.

            IF NUM_OFF = n_bit THEN

                MOVE ZERO TO ext

                PERFORM VARYING m FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL n(k) < m

                    COMPUTE point = point + 100 * k

                    ADD 1 TO num

                    IF m NOT = n(k) AND G <= point

                            MOVE 1 TO ext

ENVIRONMENT                      DIVISION.
DATA                             DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE                  SECTION.
    01 INP    PIC X(12).
    01 maxlen PIC 9(1)  VALUE 3.
    01 cur    PIC 9(12) VALUE 1.
    01 i      PIC 9(18) VALUE 1.
    01 j      PIC 9(18).
    01 len    PIC 9(12).
    01 ans    PIC X(3).

        03 A11 OCCURS 3.
            05 A PIC 9(3).
    01 tmp    PIC 9(3).
    01 sm     PIC 9(4).

    01 ZS     PIC Z(4)9.
    01 DUMMY  PIC X(1).

PROCEDURE                        DIVISION.
MAIN.
    ACCEPT INP.

    PERFORM maxlen TIMES

        PERFORM VARYING j FROM cur BY 1
            UNTIL INP(j:1) = SPACE
        END-PERFORM

        COMPUTE len = j - cur

        MOVE INP(cur:len) TO A(i)

        COMPUTE cur = j + 1

        ADD 1 TO i

    END-PERFORM.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL 3 < i
        ADD 1 TO i GIVING j
        PERFORM UNTIL 3 < j
            IF A(j) < A(i) THEN
                MOVE A(i) TO tmp
                MOVE A(j) TO A(i)
                MOVE tmp TO A(j)
            END-IF
            ADD 1 TO j
        END-PERFORM
    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE ZERO TO sm.
    SUBTRACT A(1) FROM A(2) GIVING tmp.
    ADD tmp TO sm.
    SUBTRACT A(3) FROM A(2) GIVING tmp.
    ADD tmp TO sm.

    MOVE sm TO ZS.

    PERFORM UNANS.

    DISPLAY ans(1:FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(ans)).
    STOP RUN.

UNANS                            SECTION.
    UNSTRING
        ZS DELIMITED BY ALL SPACE
        INTO DUMMY ans
    END-UNSTRING.

IDENTIFICATION                   DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID.                      ABC_103_B.
ENVIRONMENT                      DIVISION.
DATA                             DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE                  SECTION.
    01 S      PIC X(100) VALUE SPACE.
    01 REDEFINES S.

    01 SLEN   PIC 9(3).

    01 j      PIC 9(3).

    01 tmp    PIC X(1).
    01 bk     PIC X(1).

    ACCEPT S.
    ACCEPT T.

    COMPUTE SLEN = FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(S).

    MOVE ZERO TO flg.

    IF S = T THEN
        MOVE 1 TO flg
    ELSE
        PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL SLEN <= i
            MOVE SC(1) TO bk
            PERFORM VARYING j FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL SLEN <= j
                MOVE SC(j + 1) TO tmp
                MOVE bk TO SC(j + 1)
                MOVE tmp TO bk
            END-PERFORM
            MOVE bk TO SC(1)
            IF S = T THEN
                MOVE 1 TO flg
                EXIT PERFORM
            END-IF
        END-PERFORM
    END-IF.

    IF flg = 1 THEN
        DISPLAY "Yes"
    ELSE
        DISPLAY "No"
    END-IF.

    STOP RUN.

*> スタート地点に戻る lcm(B, d) / d
*> スタート地点に戻る まで 他の地点 を 2 度 訪れることはない

*> lcm(B, d) = B * d / gcd(B, d)

*> d 移動 lcm(B, d)を1回ループ B / gcd(B, d) 回
*> gcm(B, d) 移動 Bを1回ループ 最大 B - g

DATA                             DIVISION.

    01 B       PIC 9(19).

    01 ar      PIC 9(19).

                                      BY CONTENT D
                                      BY REFERENCE g

    01 N       PIC 9(5).
    01 maxlen  PIC 9(6) VALUE 110000.

        PERFORM VARYING j FROM cur BY 1
            UNTIL INP(j:1) = SPACE

        COMPUTE len = j - cur

        MOVE INP(cur:len) TO a

        ADD 1 TO i

    STOP RUN.

        INTO DUMMY ans

    DELIMITED BY SPACE

*> 階乗テーブル
*> 逆元テーブル
*> 組合せテーブル

        IF ZERO = K
            ADD 1 TO sm

        END-IF

        MOVE i TO a
        MULTIPLY AX BY a GIVING tmp

        IF K < tmp
            EXIT PERFORM
        END-IF

        DIVIDE BX INTO rm GIVING dv REMAINDER rm

*> a

            IF ZERO NOT = a AND N NOT = a

                SET MIX TO a

*> combination b
*> b
*> N - b

                IF half < b

                END-IF
                SET MIX TO b

            DIVIDE INF INTO dvx GIVING dvx REMAINDER m

                SUBTRACT INF FROM sm
            END-IF

    PERFORM UNANS.

    MOVE 1 TO i

    MOVE 1 TO V(VIX)

        MULTIPLY i BY F(FIX) GIVING t

        MOVE md TO F(FIX)

*> INF / i

*> V(INF % i) * (INF / i)

        MULTIPLY V(VIX) BY d

*> V(INF % i) * (INF / i) % INF

*> V(i) = INF - V(INF % i) * (INF / i) % INF

*> IV(i - 1) * V(i)

        MULTIPLY IV(IIX) BY V(VIX) GIVING d

*> IV(i) = IV(i - 1) * v(i) % INF

    01 str    PIC X(101) VALUE SPACE.

    01 j      PIC 9(3).

    01 cnt    PIC 9(2)   VALUE 0.
    01 cntmax PIC 9(2)   VALUE 0.

    01 ycnt   PIC 9(2)   VALUE 0.

    01 YNUM   PIC 9(2)   VALUE 0.

    01 wky    PIC X(1).

            88 NO-MORE-X1  VALUE "Y".
        03 Y1-EMPTY PIC X  VALUE "N".
            88 NO-MORE-Y1  VALUE "Y".

        03 X1-STATUS PIC XX.

    01 YSTATUS.
        03 Y1-STATUS PIC XX.

PROCEDURE                        DIVISION.
MAIN.
    ACCEPT N.
    ACCEPT S.

    CLOSE X1.

    MOVE SPACE TO wky.

        MOVE S(i : len) TO chr

        OPEN EXTEND X1
        MOVE chr TO X
        ADD 1 TO XNUM
        WRITE X11
        CLOSE X1

        MOVE SPACE TO wkx
        MOVE 0 TO xcnt

        IF X1-STATUS = "00" THEN

                ASCENDING KEY XS
                WITH DUPLICATES IN ORDER
                    USING X1
                    OUTPUT PROCEDURE IS CREATE-X1LIST
        END-IF

        OPEN OUTPUT Y1
        CLOSE Y1

        COMPUTE cur = i + 1

        MOVE S(cur : N - i) TO str

        OPEN OUTPUT Y1

        PERFORM VARYING yidx FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL N - 1 < yidx
            MOVE str(yidx : len) TO chr
            WRITE Y11 FROM chr
        END-PERFORM

        CLOSE Y1

        SUBTRACT i FROM N GIVING YNUM
        MOVE SPACE TO wky

        IF "00" = Y1-STATUS THEN
            SORT YS1
                ASCENDING KEY YS
                WITH DUPLICATES IN ORDER
                    USING Y1
                    OUTPUT PROCEDURE IS CREATE-Y1LIST
        END-IF

        MOVE xcnt TO XNUM
        MOVE ycnt TO YNUM
        MOVE 0 TO cnt

        OPEN INPUT X1

        IF "00" = X1-STATUS THEN
            MOVE "N" TO X1-EMPTY
            PERFORM UNTIL NO-MORE-X1
                READ X1
                    AT END
                        MOVE "Y" TO X1-EMPTY
                    NOT AT END

                        OPEN INPUT Y1

                        IF "00" = Y1-STATUS THEN
                            MOVE "N" TO Y1-EMPTY
                            PERFORM UNTIL NO-MORE-Y1
                                READ Y1
                                    AT END
                                        MOVE "Y" TO Y1-EMPTY
                                    NOT AT END

                                            ADD 1 TO cnt
                                        END-IF
                            END-PERFORM
                        END-IF

                        CLOSE Y1

            END-PERFORM
        END-IF

        CLOSE X1

        COMPUTE cntmax = FUNCTION MAX(cntmax, cnt)

    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE cntmax TO ans.

    DISPLAY ans.

    OPEN OUTPUT X1.
    CLOSE X1.

    OPEN OUTPUT Y1.
    CLOSE Y1.

    STOP RUN.

    OPEN OUTPUT X1
    CLOSE X1

    OPEN EXTEND X1

    MOVE "NO" TO X1-EMPTY
    PERFORM UPDATE-X1LIST
        UNTIL NO-MORE-X1

    CLOSE X1.

UPDATE-X1LIST SECTION.
    RETURN XS1 INTO XS11
        AT END
            MOVE "Y" TO X1-EMPTY
        NOT AT END
            IF XS11 NOT = wkx THEN
                WRITE X11 FROM XS11
                MOVE XS TO wkx
                ADD 1 TO xcnt
            ELSE

CREATE-Y1LIST SECTION.

    CLOSE Y1

    OPEN EXTEND Y1

    MOVE "NO" TO Y1-EMPTY
    PERFORM UPDATE-Y1LIST
        UNTIL NO-MORE-Y1

UPDATE-Y1LIST SECTION.

        AT END

        NOT AT END
            IF YS11 NOT = wky THEN
                WRITE Y11 FROM YS11
                MOVE YS TO wky
                ADD 1 TO ycnt
            ELSE
                CONTINUE
            END-IF.

PROGRAM-ID.                      BOB_ALICE.
DATA                             DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE                  SECTION.
    01 INP     PIC X(600).
    01 cur     PIC 9(3)  VALUE 1.
    01 i       PIC 9(18).
    01 j       PIC 9(18).
    01 len     PIC 9(3).

    01 N       PIC 9(3).

    01 card1.
        03 card11 OCCURS 100 DEPENDING ON N.
            05 card    PIC 9(3).

    01 alice   PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
    01 bob     PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.

    01 ZS      PIC Z(5)9.
    01 ans     PIC X(5).

    01 DUMMY   PIC X(1).

    01 q       PIC 9(2).
    01 r       PIC 9(1).

PROCEDURE                        DIVISION.
    ACCEPT N.

    ACCEPT INP.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL N < i

        PERFORM VARYING j FROM cur BY 1
            UNTIL INP(j:1) = SPACE
        END-PERFORM

        COMPUTE len = j - cur

        MOVE INP(cur:len) TO card(i)

        COMPUTE cur = j + 1

    END-PERFORM.

    SORT card11 ON DESCENDING KEY card.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL N < i
        DIVIDE 2 INTO i GIVING q REMAINDER r
        IF R = 0 THEN
            ADD card(i) TO bob
        ELSE
            ADD card(i) TO alice
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM.

    SUBTRACT bob FROM alice.
    MOVE alice TO ZS.

    PERFORM UNANS.

    DISPLAY ans(1:FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(ans)).
    STOP RUN.

UNANS                            SECTION.
    UNSTRING
        ZS DELIMITED BY ALL SPACE
        INTO DUMMY ans
    END-UNSTRING.

IDENTIFICATION                   DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID.                      ABC_088_B.
ENVIRONMENT                      DIVISION.
DATA                             DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE                  SECTION.
    01 INP    PIC X(600).
    01 maxlen PIC 9(3).
    01 cur    PIC 9(3)  VALUE 1.
    01 i      PIC 9(18).
    01 j      PIC 9(18).
    01 len    PIC 9(3).

    01 N      PIC 9(3).

    01 qary1.
        03 qary11 OCCURS 100.
            05 qary    PIC 9(3).

    01 stack1.
        03 stack11 OCCURS 1000.
            05 st    PIC 9(3).
            05 ed    PIC 9(3).

    01 sidx   PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
    01 nowidx PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.

    01 sttmp  PIC 9(3).
    01 edtmp  PIC 9(3).

    01 a      PIC 9(3).
    01 b      PIC 9(3).

    01 t      PIC 9(3).
    01 x      PIC 9(3).

    01 qfirst PIC 9(3) VALUE 1.
    01 qlast  PIC 9(3).
    01 q      PIC 9(3).

    01 ret    PIC 9(3).
    01 bk     PIC 9(3).

    01 alice  PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
    01 bob    PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.

    01 D      PIC 9(5).
    01 R      PIC 9(5).

    01 ZS     PIC Z(5)9.
    01 ans    PIC X(5).

    01 DUMMY  PIC X(1).

    01 FLG    PIC 9(1).

    01 num    PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.

PROCEDURE                        DIVISION.
MAIN.
    ACCEPT N.

    ACCEPT INP.

    MOVE N TO maxlen.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL maxlen < i

        PERFORM VARYING j FROM cur BY 1
            UNTIL INP(j:1) = SPACE
        END-PERFORM

        COMPUTE len = j - cur

        MOVE INP(cur:len) TO qary(i)

        COMPUTE cur = j + 1

    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE N TO qlast.

    PERFORM PARTITION.

    MOVE 1 TO FLG.

    PERFORM UNTIL FLG = 0
        PERFORM QSORT
        IF FLG = 0 THEN
            IF nowidx < sidx THEN
                MOVE 1 TO FLG
                ADD 1 TO nowidx
                MOVE st(nowidx) TO qfirst
                MOVE ed(nowidx) TO qlast
                PERFORM PARTITION
            END-IF
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM N BY -1 UNTIL i <= 0
        ADD 1 TO num
        DIVIDE 2 INTO num GIVING D REMAINDER R
        IF R = 0 THEN
            ADD qary(i) TO bob
        ELSE
            ADD qary(i) TO alice
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM.

    SUBTRACT bob FROM alice.
    MOVE alice TO ZS.

    PERFORM UNANS.

    DISPLAY ans(1:FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(ans)).
    STOP RUN.

UNANS                            SECTION.
    UNSTRING
        ZS DELIMITED BY ALL SPACE
        INTO DUMMY ans
    END-UNSTRING.

PARTITION                        SECTION.
    MOVE qary(qlast) TO x
    MOVE qfirst TO a

    SUBTRACT 1 FROM a

    PERFORM VARYING b FROM qfirst BY 1 UNTIL qlast <= b
        IF qary(b) <= x THEN
            ADD 1 TO a
            MOVE qary(a) TO t
            MOVE qary(b) TO qary(a)
            MOVE t TO qary(b)
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM

    ADD 1 TO a
    MOVE qary(a) TO t
    MOVE qary(qlast) TO qary(a)
    MOVE t TO qary(qlast)
    MOVE a TO q.

QSORT                            SECTION.
    IF qfirst < qlast THEN
        MOVE q TO ret

        MOVE qlast TO bk
        SUBTRACT 1 FROM ret GIVING qlast

        ADD 1 ret GIVING sttmp
        MOVE bk TO edtmp

        IF sttmp < edtmp THEN
            ADD 1 TO sidx
            MOVE sttmp TO st(sidx)
            MOVE edtmp TO ed(sidx)
        END-IF

        IF qfirst < qlast THEN
            PERFORM PARTITION
        ELSE
            MOVE 0 TO FLG
        END-IF
    ELSE
        MOVE 0 TO FLG
    END-IF.

IDENTIFICATION                   DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID.                      ABC_085_B.
ENVIRONMENT                      DIVISION.
DATA                             DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE                  SECTION.
    01 N      PIC 9(3).
    01 i      PIC 9(3).

    01 qary1.
        03 qary11 OCCURS 100.
            05 qary    PIC 9(3).

    01 stack1.
        03 stack11 OCCURS 1000.
            05 st    PIC 9(3).
            05 ed    PIC 9(3).

    01 sidx   PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
    01 nowidx PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.

    01 sttmp  PIC 9(3).
    01 edtmp  PIC 9(3).

    01 a      PIC 9(3).
    01 b      PIC 9(3).

    01 t      PIC 9(3).
    01 x      PIC 9(3).

    01 qfirst PIC 9(3) VALUE 1.
    01 qlast  PIC 9(3).
    01 q      PIC 9(3).

    01 ret    PIC 9(3).
    01 bk     PIC 9(3).

    01 ZS     PIC Z(4).
    01 ans    PIC X(3).

    01 DUMMY  PIC X(1).

    01 FLG    PIC 9(1).

    01 tmp    PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
    01 cnt    PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.

PROCEDURE                        DIVISION.
MAIN.
    ACCEPT N.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL N < i
        ACCEPT qary(i)
    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE N TO qlast.

    PERFORM PARTITION.

    MOVE 1 TO FLG.

    PERFORM UNTIL FLG = 0
        PERFORM QSORT
        IF FLG = 0 THEN
            IF nowidx < sidx THEN
                MOVE 1 TO FLG
                ADD 1 TO nowidx
                MOVE st(nowidx) TO qfirst
                MOVE ed(nowidx) TO qlast
                PERFORM PARTITION
            END-IF
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL N < i
        IF tmp < qary(i) THEN
            ADD 1 TO cnt
        END-IF

        MOVE qary(i) TO tmp
    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE cnt TO ZS.

    PERFORM UNANS.

    DISPLAY ans(1:FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(ans)).
    STOP RUN.

UNANS                            SECTION.
    UNSTRING
        ZS DELIMITED BY ALL SPACE
        INTO DUMMY ans
    END-UNSTRING.

PARTITION                        SECTION.
    MOVE qary(qlast) TO x
    MOVE qfirst TO a

    SUBTRACT 1 FROM a

    PERFORM VARYING b FROM qfirst BY 1 UNTIL qlast <= b
        IF qary(b) <= x THEN
            ADD 1 TO a
            MOVE qary(a) TO t
            MOVE qary(b) TO qary(a)
            MOVE t TO qary(b)
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM

    ADD 1 TO a
    MOVE qary(a) TO t
    MOVE qary(qlast) TO qary(a)
    MOVE t TO qary(qlast)
    MOVE a TO q.

QSORT                            SECTION.
    IF qfirst < qlast THEN
        MOVE q TO ret

        MOVE qlast TO bk
        SUBTRACT 1 FROM ret GIVING qlast

        ADD 1 ret GIVING sttmp
        MOVE bk TO edtmp

        IF sttmp < edtmp THEN
            ADD 1 TO sidx
            MOVE sttmp TO st(sidx)
            MOVE edtmp TO ed(sidx)
        END-IF

        IF qfirst < qlast THEN
            PERFORM PARTITION
        ELSE
            MOVE 0 TO FLG
        END-IF
    ELSE
        MOVE 0 TO FLG
    END-IF.

    01 nowidx PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.

    01 sttmp  PIC 9(3).
    01 edtmp  PIC 9(3).

    01 b      PIC 9(3).

    01 x      PIC X(1).

    01 qlast  PIC 9(3).

    01 tlast  PIC 9(3).
    01 xlast  PIC 9(3).

    01 ans    PIC X(5).

PROCEDURE                        DIVISION.
MAIN.
    ACCEPT INP.

    ACCEPT INP2.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL INP(i:1) = SPACE
        MOVE INP(i:1) TO qary OF qary11(i)
    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE 1 TO qfirst.
    MOVE slast TO qlast.

    PERFORM PARTITION.

    MOVE 1 TO FLG.

    PERFORM UNTIL FLG = 0
        PERFORM QSORT
        IF FLG = 0 THEN
            IF nowidx < sidx THEN
                MOVE 1 TO FLG
                ADD 1 TO nowidx
                MOVE st(nowidx) TO qfirst
                MOVE ed(nowidx) TO qlast
                PERFORM PARTITION
            END-IF
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL slast < i
        MOVE qary OF qary11(i) TO qary OF sary11(i)
    END-PERFORM.

    INITIALIZE qary1.
    INITIALIZE stack1.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL INP2(i:1) = SPACE

    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE tlast TO qlast.

    MOVE 0 TO nowidx.

    MOVE 1 TO FLG.

    PERFORM UNTIL FLG = 0
        PERFORM QSORT
        IF FLG = 0 THEN
            IF nowidx < sidx THEN
                MOVE 1 TO FLG
                ADD 1 TO nowidx
                MOVE st(nowidx) TO qfirst
                MOVE ed(nowidx) TO qlast
                PERFORM PARTITION
            END-IF
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE tlast TO j.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL tlast < i
        MOVE qary OF qary11(j) TO qary OF tary11(i)
        SUBTRACT 1 FROM j
    END-PERFORM.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL xlast < i

        ELSE
            IF qary OF tary11(i) < qary OF sary11(i) THEN
                MOVE 0 TO judge
                EXIT PERFORM
            END-IF
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM.

    IF tlast <= slast AND judge = 9 THEN

    END-IF

    IF judge = 0 THEN
        DISPLAY "No"
    ELSE
        DISPLAY "Yes"
    END-IF.

    STOP RUN.

    MOVE qary OF qary11(qlast) TO x
    MOVE qfirst TO a

    SUBTRACT 1 FROM a

    PERFORM VARYING b FROM qfirst BY 1 UNTIL qlast <= b

            MOVE qary OF qary11(a) TO t
            MOVE qary OF qary11(b) TO qary OF qary11(a)
            MOVE t TO qary OF qary11(b)
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM

    MOVE qary OF qary11(a) TO t
    MOVE qary OF qary11(qlast) TO qary OF qary11(a)
    MOVE t TO qary OF qary11(qlast)
    MOVE a TO q.

    IF qfirst < qlast THEN
        MOVE q TO ret

        MOVE qlast TO bk
        SUBTRACT 1 FROM ret GIVING qlast

        MOVE bk TO edtmp

            ADD 1 TO sidx
            MOVE sttmp TO st(sidx)
            MOVE edtmp TO ed(sidx)
        END-IF

            PERFORM PARTITION
        ELSE
            MOVE 0 TO FLG
        END-IF
    ELSE

    END-IF.

        03 stack11 OCCURS 1000.
            05 st    PIC 9(2).
            05 ed    PIC 9(2).

    01 sidx   PIC 9(2) VALUE 0.
    01 nowidx PIC 9(2) VALUE 0.

    01 sttmp  PIC 9(2).
    01 edtmp  PIC 9(2).

    01 a      PIC 9(2).
    01 b      PIC 9(2).

    01 t      PIC 9(2).
    01 x      PIC 9(2).

    01 qfirst PIC 9(2).
    01 qlast  PIC 9(2).
    01 q      PIC 9(2).

    01 ret    PIC 9(2).
    01 bk     PIC 9(2).

    01 ZS     PIC Z(5).
    01 ans    PIC X(4).

    01 DUMMY  PIC X(1).

    01 FLG    PIC 9(1).

    01 num    PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.

PROCEDURE                        DIVISION.
MAIN.
    ACCEPT NK.

    UNSTRING NK
    DELIMITED BY SPACE
    INTO N K.

    ACCEPT INP.

    MOVE N TO maxlen.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL maxlen < i

        PERFORM VARYING j FROM cur BY 1
            UNTIL INP(j:1) = SPACE
        END-PERFORM

        COMPUTE len = j - cur

        MOVE INP(cur:len) TO qary(i)

        COMPUTE cur = j + 1

    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE 1 TO qfirst.
    MOVE N TO qlast.

    PERFORM PARTITION.

    MOVE 1 TO FLG.

    PERFORM UNTIL FLG = 0
        PERFORM QSORT
        IF FLG = 0 THEN
            IF nowidx < sidx THEN
                MOVE 1 TO FLG
                ADD 1 TO nowidx
                MOVE st(nowidx) TO qfirst
                MOVE ed(nowidx) TO qlast
                PERFORM PARTITION
            END-IF
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE 0 TO mx.

    PERFORM VARYING i FROM N BY -1 UNTIL i <= N - K
        ADD qary(i) TO mx
    END-PERFORM.

    MOVE mx TO ZS.

    PERFORM UNANS.

    DISPLAY ans(1:FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(ans)).
    STOP RUN.

UNANS                            SECTION.
    UNSTRING
        ZS DELIMITED BY ALL SPACE
        INTO DUMMY ans
    END-UNSTRING.

PARTITION                        SECTION.
    MOVE qary(qlast) TO x
    MOVE qfirst TO a

    SUBTRACT 1 FROM a

    PERFORM VARYING b FROM qfirst BY 1 UNTIL qlast <= b
        IF qary(b) <= x THEN
            ADD 1 TO a
            MOVE qary(a) TO t
            MOVE qary(b) TO qary(a)
            MOVE t TO qary(b)
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM

    ADD 1 TO a
    MOVE qary(a) TO t
    MOVE qary(qlast) TO qary(a)
    MOVE t TO qary(qlast)
    MOVE a TO q.

QSORT                            SECTION.
    IF qfirst < qlast THEN
        MOVE q TO ret

        MOVE qlast TO bk
        SUBTRACT 1 FROM ret GIVING qlast

        ADD 1 ret GIVING sttmp
        MOVE bk TO edtmp

        IF sttmp < edtmp THEN
            ADD 1 TO sidx
            MOVE sttmp TO st(sidx)
            MOVE edtmp TO ed(sidx)
        END-IF

        IF qfirst < qlast THEN
            PERFORM PARTITION
        ELSE
            MOVE 0 TO FLG
        END-IF
    ELSE
        MOVE 0 TO FLG
    END-IF.

    01 S       PIC X(100000).
    01 dr      PIC X(7) VALUE "dreamer".
    01 er      PIC X(6) VALUE "eraser".
    01 d       PIC X(5) VALUE "dream".
    01 e       PIC X(5) VALUE "erase".

    01 word    PIC X(7).
    01 wordlen PIC 9(1).

    01 len     PIC 9(6).
    01 bklen   PIC 9(6).

    01 drlen   PIC 9(1).
    01 erlen   PIC 9(1).
    01 dlen    PIC 9(1).
    01 elen    PIC 9(1).

    01 flg     PIC 9(1) VALUE ZERO.

PROCEDURE                        DIVISION.
    OPEN INPUT SYSIN.

    CLOSE SYSIN.

    COMPUTE drlen = FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(dr).
    COMPUTE erlen = FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(er).
    COMPUTE dlen = FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(d).
    COMPUTE elen = FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(e).

    COMPUTE len = FUNCTION STORED-CHAR-LENGTH(S).
    MOVE ZERO TO bklen.
    PERFORM UNTIL flg NOT = ZERO

        IF len = ZERO THEN
            MOVE 1 TO flg
        END-IF

        IF len = bklen THEN
            EXIT PERFORM
        END-IF

        MOVE len TO bklen

        MOVE dr TO word
        MOVE drlen TO wordlen
        PERFORM ERASEWORD

        MOVE er TO word
        MOVE erlen TO wordlen
        PERFORM ERASEWORD

        MOVE d TO word
        MOVE dlen TO wordlen
        PERFORM ERASEWORD

        MOVE e TO word
        MOVE elen TO wordlen
        PERFORM ERASEWORD

    END-PERFORM.

    IF flg = 1 THEN
        DISPLAY "YES"
    ELSE
        DISPLAY "NO"
    END-IF.

    STOP RUN.

ERASEWORD                        SECTION.
    IF ZERO <= len - wordlen THEN
        IF S(len - wordlen + 1:wordlen) = word THEN
            MOVE ALL SPACE TO S(len - wordlen + 1:wordlen)
        END-IF
    END-IF.

        COMPUTE tmp = FUNCTION MOD(cnt(i), 2)

            EXIT PERFORM
        END-IF
    END-PERFORM.

        DISPLAY "Yes"
    ELSE
        DISPLAY "No"
    END-IF.
